bias.zh: 下跌趋势 · 守住 $122.2，位于 $117.4 低点上方

read.en: The Nasdaq ADS slipped 0.1% on Nov 18 to $122.47, trading $119.89–125.50 on light volume (0.51x the 20-day average). It is below the 5-day ($127.4), 10-day ($129.4) and 30-day ($142.8), all falling (no 100-day or 200-day yet, 93 sessions). MACD has been below its signal since Nov 16, below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 5 ($156.21), and RSI is 37.9.
read.zh: 纳斯达克 ADS 11月18日微跌 0.1%，收于 $122.47，盘中区间 $119.89–125.50，成交量偏低（为 20 日均量的 0.51 倍）。股价位于 5 日（$127.4）、10 日（$129.4）和 30 日均线（$142.8）下方，三者均在下行（上市仅 93 个交易日，尚无 100、200 日均线）。MACD 自 11月16日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图放大；抛物线 SAR 自 11月5日起看空（$156.21），RSI 为 37.9。

read.en: No level changed: the $125.50 high was rejected at the $124.8–126 band, and the $119.89 low undercut the Nov 16 low ($120.54) intraday, but the close held the Nov 5 low ($122.20). Resistance is $123.6–123.9, then $124.8–126 and $127.3–129.7 (5-day, 10-day). Support is $122.2, then $119.9–120.5 and $117.4 (Nov 17 low). A close above $123.9 would target $126; below $119.9, $117.4.

r.en: Nov 6 low $124.83; Nov 18 high $125.50; Nov 16 high $125.95

s.en: Nov 18 low $119.89; Nov 16 low $120.54; round number $120

bias.zh: 下跌趋势 · 反弹至 5 日均线，重回 ₩111 万上方

read.en: The latest Seoul bar is flat at ₩1,144,000, carrying the Nov 17 close; that session rose 4.2% from ₩1,098,000, trading ₩1,108,000–1,173,000. The close sits at the falling 5-day (₩1,144,400), below the falling 10-day (₩1,173,300), 30-day (₩1,309,500) and 100-day (₩1,673,500) and the rising 200-day (₩1,526,900). MACD has been below its signal since Nov 15, below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 4 (₩1,429,200), and RSI is 38.4.
read.zh: SK 海力士首尔最新 K 线持平于 ₩1,144,000，沿用 11月17日收盘价；该交易日自 ₩1,098,000 上涨 4.2%，盘中区间 ₩1,108,000–1,173,000。收盘价位于下行的 5 日均线（₩1,144,400）附近，低于下行的 10 日（₩1,173,300）、30 日（₩1,309,500）和 100 日均线（₩1,673,500）以及上行的 200 日均线（₩1,526,900）。MACD 自 11月15日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 11月4日起看空（₩1,429,200），RSI 为 38.4。

read.en: The Nov 17 rebound reclaimed ₩1,113,000–1,136,000 (Nov 15 and 8 lows, Nov 5 and 8 closes), now support, but the high stalled at the Oct 22 low (₩1,171,000). Resistance is ₩1,144,400–1,150,000 (5-day, Nov 16 high), then ₩1,171,000–1,173,300 (10-day) and ₩1,201,000–1,222,000. Support is ₩1,113,000–1,136,000, then ₩1,089,000–1,098,000 and ₩1,000,000. A close above ₩1,173,300 would target ₩1,201,000–1,222,000; below ₩1,113,000, ₩1,089,000.

s.en: Nov 15 low ₩1,113,000 and Nov 8 low ₩1,116,000, reclaimed; Nov 5 and 8 closes ₩1,132,000–1,136,000
